name: courier
description: WS-R.15.4a — the Licio native Android courier: a Capacitor shell that loads the UNCHANGED web build inside the system WebView and carries the same LCAP packs over native radio links. No courier-only web fork, no parallel data model.

scripts.build:apk: cap sync android && cd android && (./gradlew --offline assembleDebug || ./gradlew assembleDebug)
scripts.build: node ./scripts/check-no-fork.mjs && cap sync android && node ./scripts/check-no-fork.mjs --assets && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
